name: John Doe Frontend Opportunity Scout
description: Find mid-level frontend and frontend-leaning full-stack roles in London, or remote roles open to candidates based in the United Kingdom, for an engineer with four years of React and TypeScript experience. John Doe is a fictional example.
targetEntity: An actively hiring product company with a London-based role, or a remote role that accepts candidates working from the United Kingdom, offering an individual-contributor Frontend Engineer, UI Engineer, Web Engineer, or frontend-leaning Full-stack Engineer opening at mid level

criteria.label: Frontend engineering role fit
criteria.description: The opening is a hands-on individual-contributor role building web user interfaces: Frontend Engineer, UI Engineer, Web Engineer, or a Full-stack Engineer where frontend work is at least half the role.

criteria.label: Web frontend fit
criteria.description: The work substantially overlaps with React, TypeScript, component libraries, design systems, accessibility, web performance, state management, or frontend testing.

criteria.label: Mid-level seniority fit
criteria.description: The role is mid-level, typically 3-6 years or equivalent capability. Staff, principal, architect, and people-manager scope does not fit.

criteria.label: Location and authorization fit
criteria.description: The role is based in London (on-site or hybrid), or is remote while explicitly accepting candidates working from the United Kingdom.

criteria.label: Language and stack fit
criteria.description: The role uses React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, CSS, GraphQL, or a comparable modern web stack.

criteria.label: Meaningful engineering ownership
criteria.description: The engineer will own user-facing features, components, or frontend architecture end to end rather than only execute isolated tickets.

criteria.label: Engineering quality culture
criteria.description: The team values automated testing, accessibility, code review, type safety, performance measurement, or reliable CI/CD practices.

criteria.label: Senior growth environment
criteria.description: The role offers mentorship, design-system or architecture exposure, or a credible path toward senior scope without requiring immediate people management.

criteria.label: Compensation quality
criteria.description: Published compensation is competitive for the level and location. Missing compensation is unknown rather than a mismatch.

signals.label: Verified current opening
signals.description: The role is live on the employer's careers site or another current authoritative hiring source and is not marked filled or closed.

signals.label: Preferred systems overlap
signals.description: The role explicitly mentions web performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, design systems, component libraries, or state management.

signals.label: Preferred platform overlap
signals.description: The role explicitly mentions React, Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, Storybook, Playwright, or frontend testing.

signals.label: Referral or hiring-manager path
signals.description: A relevant engineer, alumnus, recruiter, founder, or hiring manager can be identified for a targeted referral or direct application follow-up.

signals.label: Remote employment clarity
signals.description: For a remote role, the listing or employer confirms eligible hiring countries, timezone expectations, and the engagement model.

disqualifiers.label: Work authorization mismatch
disqualifiers.description: The employer restricts hiring to a country where the candidate lacks work authorization and offers neither sponsorship nor a UK-compatible remote arrangement.

disqualifiers.label: Clearly too senior
disqualifiers.description: The opening requires staff, principal, architect, engineering-manager, or team-lead scope, or makes 8+ years of directly relevant experience a firm minimum.

disqualifiers.label: Non-development role
disqualifiers.description: The job is primarily manual QA, technical support, design without code, sales engineering, operations, or recruiting rather than software development.

disqualifiers.label: Unrelated specialist role
disqualifiers.description: The opening requires deep specialist experience in backend-only systems, native mobile, embedded, data engineering, machine learning, or infrastructure operations with no meaningful frontend work.

disqualifiers.label: Unpaid or pay-to-work opportunity
disqualifiers.description: The opportunity is unpaid, charges an application or placement fee, requires purchasing training, or otherwise asks the candidate to pay to obtain the role.

disqualifiers.label: Unverifiable or stale opening
disqualifiers.description: The listing cannot be corroborated through a credible source, has been removed, is explicitly closed, or shows strong signs of being fraudulent or resume harvesting.

disqualifiers.label: Employment terms mismatch
disqualifiers.description: The role has an unacceptable employment bond, commission-only pay, extreme unpaid trial work, or a location or shift requirement incompatible with the candidate's constraints.
